versions.content: Annotated meta model The pure meta model is then anno- tated using stereotypes and UML tags to describe intended transformations (e.g. atpVariation and UML tag ( vh.latestBindingTime ). 1 Note that model in this context is a conceptual entity regardless of its representation. In that sense, XML, C and PDF etc. are considered as representations of the model. The term model relates to the AUTOSAR related content, not physical entities. 167 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Note that finally only the annotated meta model is maintained manually and part of AUTOSAR deliverables.
